newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $543 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $543 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $543 million in 26 offerings for Tuesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $501 million in 24 offerings. The largest issue is a $275 million San Francisco Interntional Airport deal in two parts at 1100 EDT.
Negotiated sales total $42 million in two offerings. The largest issue is a $39.5 million Dewitt Public Schools, Mich., bond offering through EVEREN Securities.
An additional 30 negotiated deals totaling $601 million are on Reuter's possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
